author: Scopoli, 1769
status: 나그네새·겨울철새, 해마다 10만 마리 이상 · 여름에도 드물게 기록
habitat: 호수, 저수지, 강, 해안, 간척지 등의 습지, 농경지
summary: 큰 무리를 지어 전국의 호수와 저수지, 강, 해안, 간척지 등의 습지와 농경지에서 겨울을 나는 비교적 흔한 겨울철새로, 대부분 큰기러기 무리에 섞여 지낸다. 평야와 해안의 트인 습지나 추수가 끝난 농경지에서 낟알, 벼 그루터기, 풀잎·줄기·뿌리 등을 먹는다. 늘 무리 지어 움직이고 경계심이 강하며, 잘 때는 머리를 등 깃에 묻고 한 다리로 서거나 배를 땅에 댄다. 유라시아와 북아메리카 일부, 그린란드의 북극권에서 번식하는데, 한배에 흰 알을 6~7개 낳는다.

points.en: white blaze between the eye and the bill
grey-brown upperparts with white feather edges
grey-brown to whitish breast and belly with black blotches
pinkish to pale bill and legs

art.subject: Greater White-fronted Goose (Anser albifrons), adult in winter (October to March in Korea): a white blaze around the base of the upper mandible running onto the forehead, edged by a dark brown border; rest of the head and neck plain dark grey-brown; mantle and wing coverts grey-brown with pale buff fringes giving a neatly barred look; breast pale grey-brown; belly paler with irregular broad black bars and blotches; flanks dark grey-brown topped by a white line; vent and undertail white; narrow white uppertail band above a dark tail tipped white; pink bill with a whitish nail; dark brown eye with no coloured eye-ring; orange legs and feet.
art.pose: grazing in a flock on harvested farmland, one bird alert with head raised
art.scene: open Korean farmland beside a reservoir in winter, rice stubble after the harvest; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing: white blaze at the bill base and forehead, dark grey-brown head and neck, upperparts barred by pale fringes, irregular black bars across the belly, white vent, pink bill with white nail, orange legs

adult resting, side view: standing on one leg with the neck drawn down into the shoulders and the head facing forward, bill tilted down onto the breast, white forehead blaze and black belly bars still visible
art.build: Medium-large grey goose, about 75cm: noticeably smaller and shorter-necked than the bean geese it often flocks with, well larger than a Mallard. Rounded head, medium neck, compact body. Bill shorter than the head, fairly deep at the base and evenly tapered, pink with a white nail. Legs medium length, orange. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. Tail short, dark with a white tip. In flight shows a grey-brown upperwing, a white uppertail band and, from below, the black-barred belly.
avoid: Do not let the white blaze reach up between the eyes onto the crown, and do not add a yellow eye-ring; those mark Lesser White-fronted Goose.
Do not paint a black bill with an orange band; that is a bean goose. The bill is pink.
Do not paint pink legs; the legs and feet are orange.
Do not leave the adult belly plain; it carries irregular black bars, which only juveniles lack.
